workflowRecommendation: One implementer, sequential phases (implement → test → review → .legion/ deletion → approve → retro → merger). No sub-planning, no child issues, no plan file in the repository. Rebase only if GitHub reports CONFLICTING; re-run a flaky job in place with `legion gh -- run rerun <run-id> --failed`, never by pushing.
concerns: WORKSPACE TRAP: the working copy `@` carries a tracked, 0-byte `.omp/config.yml` (harness-created, not on main, no .gitignore). It must never reach any commit or the PR (spec Requirements: no `.omp/` paths reach main; acceptance 2). Every phase commits with a path-scoped `jj split -m ... <path>` from the working copy so `.omp/config.yml` stays in `@` as the remainder, and moves the bookmark with `jj bookmark set legion/LEGSMOKE-104 -r @-` (never bare `bookmark set`, which targets `@`). Never `jj new` from `@` or `jj describe @` in this workspace — that would pull the `.omp/` remainder into the pushed chain. LEGSMOKE-3's implementer hit and avoided the same trap.

Bookmark `legion/LEGSMOKE-104` is provisioned locally (`@git` tracked, no `@origin`); the planner did not push it. After the planner's `jj split`, jj moved it onto the remainder commit `@` (which holds .omp/config.yml), so a bare `jj git push --bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-104` would target the wrong commit. Every phase re-points it with `-r @-` right before pushing; the implementer's first push publishes it.
No `.legion/architect.json` exists in the workspace (no architect handoff preceded plan on this child issue); nothing else in `.legion/` either. plan.json is the first ledger entry.

The READY template's `pr-checks-result` run does not exist in this repository; the only workflows are `ci` (job `check`) and `fail-on-demand` (job `gate`). The CI line names those two run ids at the head SHA.
Thermo line omitted entirely: the change is a single markdown marker file (docs-only per the skill); the reviewer confirms and may add a Thermo line only if it disagrees.
`gh` on PATH is the `legion gh --` shim; the spec's `gh ...` commands are `legion gh -- ...` and need `--repo sjawhar/legion-smoke` (the workspace has no gh default repo).

TOOLING TRAP: in the harness bash tool, bare `cmp` resolves to a shadowing aux util that fails on process substitution (`cmp: /dev/fd/62: Illegal seek`, exit 2). Use `/usr/bin/cmp` (GNU diffutils 3.10) for every byte comparison, or write both sides to files under /tmp first. Verified by the planner: GNU cmp positive → silent exit 0; one-character negative → `- /dev/fd/63 differ: byte 100, line 1`, exit 1.
